snippet.title: DEAD WISHES (horror-romance visual novel trailer)
snippet.description:
In this chaotic world, you must adapt - either to forgive or survive.

Dead Wishes is a thriller-romance visual novel created by VIOLET, an independent development team. The game is set for release on December 27, 2018.

There is currently a free demo available on our itch.io page!

Itch.io: https://vi0let.itch.io/ 
Kickstarter page (200+% funded): https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/...
Twitter: https://twitter.com/violetdevteam
Tumblr: https://deadwishes.tumblr.com/

Special thanks to YUniverse (http://www.youtube.com/c/YUniverse) for working with us to create this trailer!
